meta.notes: Campaign layout, not canonical geography (2026-11-09). Seven biomes after the Shadowdark hex terrain table: Sea of Ash (desert) in the west, big dunes and dark buttes, dry by moisture op; Silt Mires (swamp) in the south-west, flat with tower karst and black sinkhole pools; black earth downs (grassland) north of the city and on the eastern tablelands (top ~950 m, cut by a canyon draining west); the crimson coral labyrinth (forest) in the lowlands south of the city, coral only below the coral line (treeline 220 m) where wet, with coral massifs and sinkholes; tidal flats and channels (river/coast) along the drowned south coast, with sea stacks; the Dark Sea (ocean) in a 44 km crater to the south-east: rim 1.8-2.2 km, terraced inner wall, floor -1.2 km, the Deep at the centre (-2.6 km) is where the Dark Sea rises at night; no island. The rim is breached at 235 deg toward the tidal flats, sill 15 m, so the night sea pours out over the flats. The Hollow Mountains (mountain) are their own region beyond this map: their crest runs along and past the north edge (summits ~10-14 km, the Hollow Crown straddles the edge), the map holds only their south face with four glacial troughs, and the Hollow Spur (~5 km) reaches toward the city. Dark City at the map centre on a 330 m hill, Bright Castle hill 420 m. Day sea 0 m; the night tide reaches +120 m and floods the mires, the flats, the low coral and the Spire's footing; taller towers and stacks become islands. From the castle: the Spire to the south-west, the Soul Tree's crown above the Ash Ridges (keep them under ~750 m) to the west, the mountain wall; hidden: the crater water behind its rim. Wind from the south (moisture); the crater rim casts a rain shadow, offset by moisture ops on the coral and tablelands.
